dialogs.text: You're back. Is there something I can do for you?
Please help me tell my fortune!
#Paimon also wants to know what sort of luck {NICKNAME}'ll have today!
Hmm... From the pattern of the Spiritherbs' leaves... You will have good fortune.
You will find that fortune at the highest point in Watatsumi Island, in an ancient place dedicated to the gods.
Hmm... How come Paimon can't see any of that?
Hehe, this is what they call the wisdom of the local old folks.
It sounds like you're just trying to bluff Paimon...
"You will find that fortune at the highest point in Watatsumi Island, in an ancient place dedicated to the gods."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
Hehe. Good luck cannot be rushed, and what's more, even Spiritherbs need rest.
Still, I'd like to thank you for coming by to say hello to an old lady. May you have safe travels.
"You will find that fortune at the highest point in Watatsumi Island, in an ancient place dedicated to the gods."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
Oh, youngsters, how do you do?
Please help me tell my fortune!
Hehe, what's our luck gonna be like today, hmm~?
The Spiritherbs say that... you will have ill fortune.
You will have an ill-fated and unexpected encounter in a cave in the south of Watatsumi Island — a hive of scum and villainy.
Eh, it's bad luck! Uh, we should probably avoid that sort of place, huh?
Hehe. However...
Overcoming ill fate may yet bring you an unexpected boon.
A boon...? You mean treasure? Is it gonna be treasure?
I did not say that...
Oh...
But I did not say it wouldn't be that, either.
Oh, come on, Granny, why do you have to be like that?
"You will have an ill-fated and unexpected encounter in a cave in the south of Watatsumi Island — a hive of scum and villainy."
"Yet overcoming that ill fate may bring you an unexpected boon."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
"You will have an ill-fated and unexpected encounter in a cave in the south of Watatsumi Island — a hive of scum and villainy."
"Yet overcoming that ill fate may bring you an unexpected boon."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
Oh, youngsters, how do you do?
Please help me tell my fortune!
Hehe, what's our luck gonna be like today, hmm~?
The Spiritherbs say that... you will have good luck.
A gentle Electro Seelie will guide your path near the deep pool in the center of Watatsumi Island, just below the Sangonomiya Shrine.
Wow!
It should be true. These divinations have always been very accurate.
Mmm, the more you say that, the more Paimon's getting suspicious...
Don't mind Paimon, Granny.
Hehe, it's alright, it's alright. You're still young...
#Wait a minute, what are you trying to say, {NICKNAME}?
"A gentle Electro Seelie will guide your path near the deep pool in the center of Watatsumi Island, just below the Sangonomiya Shrine."
It will lead to unexpected good fortune.
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
"A gentle Electro Seelie will guide your path near the deep pool in the center of Watatsumi Island, just below the Sangonomiya Shrine."
It will lead to unexpected good fortune.
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
Oh, youngsters, how do you do?
Please help me tell my fortune!
Paimon wants to know what today will be like too!
Hmm. The Spiritherbs say that this will be an ill-fated day.
The ruined shrine in the east is shrouded in an ominous aura...
Uhh, that sounds kinda scary...
However...
Those who boldly go forth and conquer such omens will receive their just reward.
This seems quite similar to what you said before...
Ah, isn't life like that? New experiences always cloak themselves in familiar-seeming days.
"The ruined shrine in the east is shrouded in an ominous aura..."
"But should you boldly go forth and conquer such omens, you will receive your just reward."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
"The ruined shrine in the east is shrouded in an ominous aura..."
"But should you boldly go forth and conquer such omens, you will receive your just reward."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
Oh, youngsters, how do you do?
Please help me tell my fortune!
Hmm, is it gonna be good luck this time, Paimon wonders?
Oh dear, the Spiritherbs' light is rather weak at the moment. It seems they shall need some rest...
All the same, I can help you perform another divination.
Hmm. The twinkling of the Spiritherbs say that you shall have good fortune.
In the ruins to the northeast, in the ancient city that stands alone amidst the sea, a lingering spirit of mourning will light the way.
However...
You must open for her a great gate and return her to her nest of sweet slumber before the fated reward can be yours.
That was so confusing... Something something ancient city, something nest?
Haha, it's alright. I will remain here. If you cannot figure it out, you can feel free to ask me anytime.
Hey! Is she calling Paimon stupid?
"In the ruins to the northeast, in the ancient city that stands alone amidst the sea, a lingering spirit of mourning will light the way."
"Open for her a great gate and return her to her nest of sweet slumber, and the fated reward will be yours."
Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.

"Open for her a great gate and return her to her nest of sweet slumber, and the fated reward will be yours."
